en: After hanging the laundry, I sit on the porch enjoying some leisure time.
I've felt so relaxed after I got here.
I really need to cherish all this.
Just as I wonder why Shizuku is acting like this, I notice she's hiding a stack of papers behind her.
“Do you want me to look at them?”
“Don't you want to see what happens?”
I reach out to take the stack of papers, but notice that the top sheet is a bit crumpled.
It's just a blank sheet to cover the rest.
“Haha, I understand, handing over your work to someone else takes a lot of courage.”
“I remember how nervous I was when I gave away my first floral arrangement.”
“The point is this is great, Shizuku!”
“I know, I know—don't treat me like a child!”
After some small talk, I open Shizuku's novel.
The places where I had previously given feedback are all marked.
And based on my suggestions, Shizuku has added her own thoughts.
Overall, the reading experience is more complete than before.
“The changes you made are really good, I think it's much better now.”
“Could you not look at me like that?”
“I've got chocolate puffs in the fridge.”
After a while, I stack the manuscript neatly and hold it in my hands.
Shizuku, munching on a puff, watches my every move.
I give Shizuku a thumbs up.
She makes an expression I rarely see on her face.
“The development up to this point is really interesting.”
“The part where the male and female protagonists finally open up to each other is just—awesome!”
“Especially that last line, 'My future belongs to you.'”
“Just thinking about that almost makes me cry.”
“I had to hold back while reading, or I probably would've cried.”
“I could tell, you were sniffling a few times.”
“Of course, I was really focused on watching you!”
“That way, I can tell which parts affect the reader the most.”
“Haha... Hope I didn't make any weird faces.”
“Don't worry, there were plenty of weird ones.”
“But... um, I'm really glad you liked it...”
Shizuku looks like she's about to cry too.
I guess I can figure out why Shizuku was punished by her father.
“Hey... do you think there's anything that could be better?”
“But the next section is just gonna be about their perfect life together, right?”
“What's wrong, you seem a bit unsure?”
“It's hard to imagine a life like that...”
“I'm afraid the writing might just be words on a page, that they won't convey the souls of the characters.”
“Every time I think about writing the next section, I can't write a single word...”
“Like how you interact with Kasumi and Ayano daily. Just replace the characters, and it could be a source of inspiration, right?”
“Or, what about our conversation right now?”
Shizuku suddenly blushes and buries her head between her knees.
“Eh, isn't that what we're doing now?”
Shizuku lifts her head, looking at me with uncertain, fidgety eyes.
It's the first time I've seen Shizuku make such an expression. Is she thinking of something?
“No way, no way—I'm going back to my room!”
Shizuku suddenly gets up and runs off, leaving me stunned.
This is the first time I've felt this way as a man.
